<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1260
Claimant:
Michele Ramirez
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
05/17/2023
First notice of loss received from the claimant describing a rear-end collision at a low-speed intersection. The
claimant reports a wrist fracture and states the claimant was driving the insured vehicle at the time of impact. The
driver is named on the policy, and the claim has been opened for review.
06/18/2023
Spoke with the claimant by phone to confirm the sequence of events. The account given matches what was
described at first notice, and the claimant was consistent on every point discussed, including the direction of travel
and the vehicle position at impact.
07/10/2023
Police report obtained and reviewed. It confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene. No independent
witnesses were identified in the report or during follow-up calls, so the account rests on the parties and the photos.
08/11/2023
Reviewed photographs submitted by the claimant. They confirm several details of the collision, and the damage to the
rear of the vehicle is mostly in line with the described impact. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known from prior
claims or inspection notes.
11/14/2023
Medical records received. The reported wrist fracture is consistent in kind and force with a rear-end impact of this
type. Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the claimant improved. Records also note a minor strain
in the same area years ago, which healed fully and does not appear to affect the current claim.
12/01/2023
Checked the coverage history. Nothing suggests the damage occurred before the policy coverage began, and the
policy period covers the date of loss.
12/15/2023
Claim assessment updated. The collision and injury appear to be genuine and consistent with the evidence available.
Next step is to finalize the medical bill review and send the claimant a settlement letter, since the claimant is not
represented.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
